source_anchor: Page 1 identifies Order No. PSC-2025-0439-FOF-EI, issued November 24, 2025, in Docket 20250010-EI.
what_it_says: The FPL factor approval source is no longer only a search route; the official order PDF is locally fetched and extracted.
what_it_does_not_say: It is not the later 2027 true-up order or a customer cash receipt ledger.

metric_label: storm cost recovery amounts related tariffs and factors approved
source_anchor: Page 1 titles the order as approving storm cost recovery amounts and related tariffs and establishing storm cost recovery factors for January 2026 through December 2026.
what_it_says: The order approves the annual SPPCRC factor framework for the 2026 billing period.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not by itself prove every later billed dollar was collected.

metric_family: total cost recovery amount with true-up settlement-approved scenario
source_anchor: Page 8 Issue 4A lists projected total SPPCRC jurisdictional revenue requirement including true-up amounts of $984,084,441 if the 2025 Rate Case Settlement Agreement is approved.
what_it_says: The order bridges the filed Form 5P factor math to an approved cost-recovery amount scenario.
what_it_does_not_say: The order also includes an alternate settlement-declined scenario, so this row must not be treated as the only possible factor base without rate-case disposition context.

metric_label: revised tariffs approved and utilities authorized to apply factors
source_anchor: Pages 17-18 approve revised tariffs reflecting appropriate storm protection plan cost recovery factors, direct staff verification, and authorize FPL and the other utilities to apply the factors during January 2026 through December 2026.
what_it_says: The final order closes the order-level tariff/factor approval gap for the FPL SPPCRC bridge.
